text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Mihono Bourbon—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have spotted an 'interesting' doll
2 meters and 43 centimeters ahead.
Looking where Mihono Bourbon was pointing, there was a crane game filled with plushies themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It is a doll that has become popular in my class recently—a 'Paka Petit.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
They are mainly used to decorate
bags and pencil cases.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Acquiring this is estimated to potentially grant
a new "small talk" capability. However—

Mihono Bourbon is hopelessly bad with machines.
A crane game might be a bit of a high bar for her.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Acquisition difficult. Transitioning to "give up" phase.
Apologies for the 1 minute and 2 seconds of lost time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: I'm going to win it, so please cheer for me.

text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
